'''Rednax'''<ref name="Rednax">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|url=status/1487690415738261508|name=[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2022-01-30|quote=The Sebulba and Ratts Tyerell re-dresses became Sedoca / Rednax and Bogg Tyrell, and are seen in the Coruscant speeder chase and in the diner as well.|archivedate=20220205184303}}</ref> was a [[Dug]] with spotted [[Color|green]] skin.<ref name="AOTC" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref>  Rednax was sat with a drink in a booth<ref name="AOTC" /> at [[Dex's Diner]] in the [[CoCo Town]] district of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> with the [[Nuknog]]<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Slyther Bushforb]]<ref name="Bushforb">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|url=status/1487690195877064705|name=[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2022-01-27|quote=These are two Podracer models re-dressed and repurposed as new characters. Ark "Bumpy" Roose is now Slyther Bushforb, and Ebe Endicott is Oby Bobissia. A CG Mars Guo re-dress was planned but never made it to screen.|archivedate=20220205184303}}</ref> and Dug [[holovid]] [[Actor|star]] [[Seboca]].<ref name="SWCL" /> While the diner's owner, [[Dexter Jettster]], spoke with the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in another booth, Seboca got up and left the establishment, leaving Rednax to talk with Bushforb. While at the diner, Rednax wore a dark gray [[Clothing|shirt]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rednax was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Yby">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The animated character was a redressed version of the model created for [[Sebulba]],<ref name="Rednax" /> a Dug character created for the [[1999]] prequel film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Work on the animated shots in Dex's Diner was completed between [[April]] and [[May]], [[2001]], with the finalized renders then completed over the summer.<ref name="Insider63">{{InsiderCite|63|Behind the Magic}}</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Rednax's name was confirmed by<ref name="Rednax" /> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member<ref name="SW Show Interview">{{StarWarsShow|GvT2F1j-SvA|Pablo Hidalgo Extended Interview|sw_url=video/pablo-hidalgo-extended-interview}}</ref> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] on [[January 30]], [[2022]].<ref name="Rednax" /> The names for the two [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] originated in production as Rednax and Manoca,<ref name="Insider63" /> although a [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[StarWars.com]] databank entry for [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], released by [[August 9]], 2002, instead listed a Dug named [[Seboca/Legends|Seboca]] as one of the patrons.<ref name="DinerDB">{{DB|location|dexsdiner|Dex's Diner}}</ref>

[[File:RednaxOrManoca.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rednax was a redressed model of Sebulba from Episode I.]]
The first Legends source to use the name Rednax was a "[[Behind the Magic]]" article written by [[Rob Coleman]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 63|sixty-third issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider63" />—published [[November 5]], 2002—<ref name="63Date">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2002/10/news20021017.html|text=Creatures Aplenty in Insider #63}}</ref> which identified the non-spotted Dug in the diner as Rednax and the other spotted Dug as Manoca.<ref name="Insider63" /> In later sources,<ref name="Depth">{{Film|II}} DVD-ROM Depth Commentary</ref><ref name="Image">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/09/imageattack20030909.html|series=Image Attack|text=Dug Model}}</ref> the identities were then switched, with Rednax first identified as the spotted Dug in an Episode II Depth Commentary available on [[StarWars.com]] that was accessible through the DVD-ROM home release of ''Attack of the Clones''<ref name="Depth" /> on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref>

In the "[[Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A]]" section of [[Star Wars Insider 66|''Star Wars Insider'' 66]],<ref name="Insider66">{{InsiderCite|66|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref> released on [[March 4]], [[2003]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/02/news20030203.html|text=''Star Wars Insider'' #66}}</ref> [[Leland Chee]] identified Seboca as a Dug seen earlier in the film that shared an almost identical model with the non-spotted diner Dug, but still identified the two diner dugs as Rednax and Manoca.<ref name="Insider66" /> In a blog post made on [[October 10]], [[2006]], Chee then clarified that the spotted Dug at the diner was Rednax and the other was Seboca, who was also the Dug seen earlier in the film, leaving no character named Manoca,<ref name="Holocron">{{Blog|holocron|29|Mistaken Identities}}</ref> although it was later established to be a pseudonym used by Seboca in the Databank entry for [[Slyther Bushforb/Legends|Slyther Bushforb]] written by [[John Hazlett]] as part of the "[[What's The Story?]]" contest<ref name="Hazlett">{{Blog|jSarek|6|Behind the Scenes - Slyther Bushforb}}</ref> and published around [[March 27]], [[2008]].<ref name="jcf">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28246564|board=Literature|thread=Official "What's the Story?" Hyperspace Databank Feature Discussion|user=kttch809|date=2008-03-27|time=7:55 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150915174927/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/official-whats-the-story-hyperspace-databank-feature-discussion.20434695/page-96|nolive=1}}</ref>
